notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla defines CMSG_GOSSIP_HELLO, CMSG_GOSSIP_SELECT_OPTION (optional trailing code cstring omitted when absent), CMSG_NPC_TEXT_QUERY, the SMSG_GOSSIP_MESSAGE parse, the 8-block SMSG_NPC_TEXT_UPDATE parse, and the reference greeting pick (weighted random draw over non-empty blocks in the NPC-gender column, <= predicate, no cross-gender fallback). MSUI implements the wire completely and correctly (GossipPackets.ParseMenu/ParseText, WorldSession.GossipHello/GossipSelect/NpcTextQuery, SMSG_GOSSIP_COMPLETE handled) but collapses greeting selection.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: The pre-pass's lone missing item, SMSG_QUESTGIVER_, is explicitly out of scope in Benilla's gossip.rs (quest options parsed for byte alignment only), and MSUI parses the same quest block for alignment - not a gossip gap.
